Messages.Body:
Does Rosa Martinez's special activate if you do not control a vampire
with the Regent master card but rather one of the vamprires with Regent

Text on the card: "is a regent"
Text on the online cardlist: "<has the Regent card>"

"Current card text" was clearly used above as being different than
"official online card text".

The explanation above is saying that the official card text is marked
as a clarification of printed card text. It also notes that printed
card text is "is a regent". And it notes that the clarification
clarified what "is a regent" meant under the old state of affairs.
Since a clarificartion doesn't alter card text, the result should be
clear, even under "current card text".

The online official card texts were updated as soon as possible -- this
morning, to be precise.
